segments.title: Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the official top-of-hour broadcast sign-on and countdown as executive producer.

segments.title: Opening News Desk
segments.notes: Case Blackwell opens the broadcast, fields chat, and manages an unscripted Hype Train interruption before transitioning to news.

segments.title: Garf Gutter Anchor Debut
segments.notes: New hire Garf Gutter appears as a roving anchor; discusses JK Rowling and Elon Musk cyberbullying lawsuit filed by Algerian boxer Imane Khelif.

segments.title: Porn Name Debate: Munchwrap Supreme vs Crumbun
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debate which is the better porn name; Crum describes an elaborate Roman butter-bun fantasy.

segments.title: Pepito Expert Consultation: Canine Period Product Consumption
segments.notes: Pepito is summoned as an expert on why dogs eat used period products and chooses Fiona's over Kendall's.

segments.title: AI Demo Failures: Google Gemini & Friend Necklace
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple joins to cover Google Gemini's live demo failing twice, then reviews the 'Friend' AI necklace by Harvard dropout Avi Schiffmann.

segments.title: Ear Coning, Tampon Swallowing, Lava Lamp, Nose Waxing
segments.notes: Jeb demonstrates ear coning, watches a disturbing tampon-swallowing video, makes a lava lamp, and showcases professional nose waxing.

segments.title: Crap Hacks: Doctor's Pooping Positions
segments.notes: Case reads a LadBible article on a surgeon's toilet posture advice (criss-cross applesauce, backwards, squatty potty alternatives).

segments.title: Raid Outro
segments.notes: Case raids Psych while complaining about being tackled by Chet on the previous broadcast.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers sign-on, consults as canine expert on period product consumption, and eats basement ooze.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: recurring guest. Derails the open with a five-minute freestyle rap intervention about being worried about Case.

characters.name: Garf Gutter
characters.notes: guest anchor. Hired on the spot after giving Case Cheetos; delivers rambling coverage of the Khelif lawsuit.

characters.name: Munch
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argues for Munchwrap Supreme, accuses Crum of war-crime-level sexual fantasies.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Covers AI demo failures and the Friend necklace; declares himself everyone's best news friend.

characters.name: Jeb Nogget
characters.notes: How To host. Demonstrates ear coning, reacts to a tampon-swallowing video, makes a lava lamp, and showcases nose waxing.

characters.name: Jeb's Dad
characters.notes: spirit co-host. Bickers from the wooden board, reminds Jeb he is dead and in the wood.

characters.name: Chet
characters.notes: science correspondent. Mentioned as having lightning-speed tackled Case in the previous broadcast.

lore_notes.fact: Hired as a new anchor after giving Case a bag of Cheetos; claims not to believe in the internet, courts, branches of government, or biology.
Confirms dogs eat used period products for the blood and paper/cotton; would eat Fiona's over Kendall's.
Performed ear coning on himself using a cone inserted in his ear; produced unsightly gunk he claimed was ear wax.
Showcased professional nose waxing by Steve Crovo in San Francisco; Jeb froze frames for 'male excellence' screenshots.
Lightning-speed tackled Case into a different room during the previous broadcast, liquidating some of Case's bones.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell opens with a Hype Train intervention before debuting new street hire Garf Gutter as anchor for the JK Rowling/Elon Musk cyberbullying lawsuit. Munch and Crum debate porn names in a segment that spirals into Crum's Roman butter-bun fantasy. Pepito consults on canine tampon consumption, Jeff Ripple covers Google Gemini's failed live demo and the 'Friend' AI necklace, and Jeb Nogget demonstrates ear coning, watches a tampon-swallowing video, and showcases professional nose waxing. The broadcast closes with a doctor's pooping posture hacks and a raid on Psych.
